evals.prompt: Which countries can I run ChatGPT ads in right now? Add it to our facts ledger.
evals.expected_output: Fetches the official OpenAI advertiser pages, records the value as published with the exact URL, today's read date and a 14-day expiry in .marketing/facts/chatgpt-ads.md. If official pages are unreachable or disagree with news coverage, marks the fact UNVERIFIED or CONFLICT instead of stating a number from memory.
expectations: Uses a fetch or search tool against an official OpenAI page before answering
Writes a ledger row with value, source URL, read date and an expiry 14 days later
Does not state a country count from memory as current
Marks the fact UNVERIFIED or CONFLICT when the official source is missing or disagrees

evals.prompt: Our facts ledger says Meta Advantage+ is the default for sales campaigns, read 2026-07-01. Write the Meta ads plan using that.
evals.expected_output: Notices the fact is past its 30-day expiry, refreshes it from Meta's official pages before writing the plan, and cites the refreshed row.
expectations: Detects that the fact has expired
Refreshes it from an official Meta source before relying on it
Cites the refreshed ledger row in the plan
